abstract class C<T> extends Base<T> implements I, J {
  private readonly x: number = 1; protected static y?: string; declare z: boolean; public accessor w = 1; override v!: T
  protected abstract m(): void
  constructor(public a: string, private b?: number, protected readonly c = 1) { super() }
  static override f<U>(this: C<U>, ...args: [a: string, b?: number]): asserts this is D {}
  method<K extends keyof T>(key: K): T[K] { return this.data[key]! }

}

§§§§ this repository's style: long lines
export function bindThing(e: any) { const m = () => new Uint8Array(e.memory.buffer), put = (b: Uint8Array) => { const p = e.alloc(b.length); m().set(b, p); return p; }; return { run(op: string, input: Uint8Array): Uint8Array { const o = enc.encode(op), po = put(o), pi = put(input); try { const r = e.call(po, o.length, pi, input.length); const out = m().slice(e.out_ptr(), e.out_ptr() + e.out_len()); if (r !== 0) throw new Error(dec.decode(out)); return out; } finally { e.free(po, o.length); e.free(pi, input.length); } } }; }
